services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Inspections, repairs and replacements for your home.
services.text: Routine inspections, minor repairs and full roof replacements for homeowners throughout Greater Houston, with honest guidance and clear communication on every job.
services.imageAlt: Pallets of shingles and rolls of underlayment delivered to a driveway before a roof install
body: At ELK Roofing, we understand that your home is your most valuable asset, and your roof is what protects it all. Whether you need a routine inspection, minor repairs or a full roof replacement, our team is here to help.

Not every roofing company takes the time to understand your home's unique needs, but we do. From the first phone call to the final walk-through, we prioritize communication, craftsmanship and customer care. We don't upsell, we inform. And we don't cut corners, we do it right the first time.
As a family-owned roofing company, we're proud to offer hands-on service with real accountability, including direct involvement from our owner on every project.
points: Honest assessments and pressure-free recommendations
Personalized service with direct access to our owner
Skilled repairs, replacements and inspections using trusted materials
Full clean-up after every project
Lifetime workmanship and labor warranty on full roof replacements

services.title: Roof Repairs
services.short: Leaks, missing shingles and flashing, fixed fast.
services.text: Not every roofing issue requires a full replacement. We fix what needs fixing, nothing more, nothing less, so you can feel confident in your home's protection.
services.imageAlt: A cracked pipe boot around a vent pipe on a shingle roof
body: Whether you're dealing with a small leak, missing shingles or storm-related damage, our expert repair team will respond quickly, assess the issue accurately and get your roof back in shape without unnecessary upselling.

We've made roof repairs simple and stress-free. First, we schedule a free roof inspection to evaluate the issue. Then we provide a clear explanation of what needs to be fixed, along with an upfront estimate. Once approved, we make the necessary repairs using high-quality materials that match your existing roof. Most repairs are completed the same day, and we always leave your property clean and debris-free.

At ELK Roofing, we take pride in doing what's right for the homeowner and not just selling a new roof. If your roof still has years of life left, we'll help you preserve it with effective, affordable repairs. And if a full replacement makes more sense long-term, we'll explain why and walk you through your options with zero pressure.
points: Roof leaks and water intrusion, sealed at the source
Missing or damaged shingles replaced
Flashing and vent repairs around chimneys, vents and valleys
Storm and hail damage, with insurance claim assistance
Minor structural repairs: soft spots, sagging areas and wood rot

services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short: Full installation backed by a lifetime workmanship warranty.
services.text: When your roof is worn out, damaged beyond repair or simply past its prime, we provide a smooth, professional replacement that protects your home for years to come.
services.imageAlt: An aerial view of a large home with a newly installed dark shingle roof
body: Your roof takes the brunt of Houston's harsh weather, from intense sun to high winds and hail. Over time, even the best roofs will reach the end of their lifespan. If you're noticing curling shingles, frequent leaks or signs of sagging, it might be time to consider a full replacement.

We make the replacement process simple, efficient and stress-free. First, we provide a free inspection and detailed estimate based on your home's needs. Once approved, our team gets to work removing the old roof, installing new materials with precision and cleaning up every last nail. Throughout the project, you'll have direct communication with our team: no runaround, no surprises.
We offer a variety of roofing systems to match your home's style, performance needs and budget: asphalt shingles, metal roofing, impact resistant synthetic shingles, tile and slate.
points: Expert consultation on materials and options for your home and budget
Full roof removal down to the deck, with damaged underlayment replaced
Professional installation using trusted, high-quality materials
Clean-up, with every last nail picked up
Lifetime workmanship and labor warranty on your new roof

faqs.q: How do I know it's time to replace my roof?
faqs.a: Common signs are shingles that are missing, cracked or curling, a roof more than 15 to 20 years old, water stains or leaks inside your home, sagging rooflines or soft spots, and rising energy bills from poor insulation.

faqs.q: What roofing materials do you install?
faqs.a: Asphalt shingles, metal roofing, impact resistant synthetic shingles, tile and slate. Not sure what's right for your home? We'll help you compare options and make the best choice for your needs.

services.title: Storm Damage
services.short: Hail and wind damage repaired, with claim support.
services.text: When storms hit the Houston area, they bring wind, hail and chaos that can seriously compromise your roof. We respond fast, assess the full scope of the damage and get your roof back in shape.
services.imageAlt: A weathered shingle roof marked with chalk during a storm damage inspection
body: Storm damage isn't always easy to spot from the ground. You might not see missing shingles or small leaks, but even minor damage can lead to serious issues over time, like mold, wood rot or interior water damage. That's why we always recommend a professional inspection after any significant storm, even if your roof looks fine.

With over two decades of storm damage experience, we've worked with virtually every major insurance carrier and understand how to navigate the claims process with ease. Our long-standing relationships with insurers allow us to streamline communication, provide accurate documentation and help ensure you get the coverage you deserve, without unnecessary delays.

We know storm damage doesn't stop at the roof, and neither do we. In addition to expert roof repairs and replacements, our team provides a full range of storm recovery services to help you restore your home inside and out. From fallen tree removal to structural repairs, we take care of everything so you don't have to juggle multiple contractors.
points: Hail impacts: bruised, cracked or granule-shedding shingles
Wind damage: lifted, curled or missing shingles
Fallen debris: tree limbs that puncture or crush roofing materials
Leaks and water intrusion that may not surface until it's already costly
Tree and debris removal, siding, masonry and exterior repairs

services.title: Roof Inspections
services.short: A free, no-pressure look at the condition of your roof.
services.text: We offer professional roof inspections throughout Houston and the surrounding areas at no cost to you. No pressure, no scare tactics, just real answers you can trust.
services.imageAlt: A potential hail impact circled on a shingle during a roof inspection
body: A roof that looks fine from the ground could be hiding leaks, missing shingles, deteriorating flashing or storm damage. Left unchecked, these issues can lead to major problems inside your home, costing you far more down the road. A professional inspection helps you stay ahead of those costly surprises and make smart decisions about repair or replacement if needed.

We don't just do a quick glance. We take the time to thoroughly inspect all critical components of your roofing system, then share our findings in plain language, show you photos and explain any concerns so you can make an informed decision.

At ELK Roofing, we don't use inspections as a sales pitch. If your roof is in good condition, we'll tell you. If we spot minor issues, we'll recommend affordable repairs. And if replacement is truly the best option, we'll walk you through your choices and answer your questions without pressure.
points: Shingles: missing, cracked, curling or loose
Flashing around chimneys, vents and skylights
Roof valleys, which take the most water flow
Gutters and drainage: clogs, damage or poor water flow
Attic ventilation and airflow
Leaks and moisture signs, on the roof and inside the attic or ceilings

faqs.q: When should I book an inspection?
faqs.a: If you've had recent storms, hail or high winds, if you're seeing ceiling stains or damp spots, if you're buying or selling a home, if your roof is over 10 years old and hasn't been checked recently, or if you just want peace of mind.
Nothing. We provide a no-cost inspection to evaluate your roof for both visible and hidden damage, and you'll receive honest feedback, photos and a clear explanation of our findings.

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Inspections, repairs and replacements for your property.
services.text: Professional commercial roofing throughout Houston and the surrounding areas, for office buildings, retail space, warehouses, medical facilities and multi-tenant complexes.
services.imageAlt: ELK Roofing trucks and a crane at a multi-building roofing project
body: When it comes to protecting your business, your roof plays a critical role, and at ELK Roofing we make sure it does its job right. Whether you manage an office building, retail space, warehouse, medical facility or multi-tenant complex, our experienced team will tailor a solution that fits your property's needs, schedule and budget.

We understand that every minute your business is disrupted costs you money, which is why we focus on efficient service, clear communication and doing the job right the first time. With ELK Roofing, you get a commercial roofing partner, not just a contractor.

Our team is experienced with a wide range of commercial roofing materials and systems: TPO for flat or low-slope roofs, modified bitumen for high-traffic rooftops, metal, shingle for multi-family and steep-slope roofs, and built-up roofing for flat commercial roofs.
points: Roof inspections and honest assessments
Leak detection and repairs
Roof replacements, durable and energy-efficient
New installations for commercial builds
Storm damage assessments and documentation
Preventative maintenance plans

claim.title: How a storm claim works
claim.text: We've worked with virtually every major insurance carrier, and here is how the process runs from the first look at your roof.

steps.title: Roof inspection
steps.text: Let us take a look first. If there is no damage, we will tell you.

steps.title: File the claim
steps.text: If damage is found, it's time for you to file your claim. Just let us know when the adjuster will inspect your roof.

steps.title: Adjuster and ELK meet
steps.text: Having ELK Roofing at the meeting with the adjuster helps ensure all components are accounted for.

steps.title: Estimate letter and check
steps.text: Once the adjuster has inspected your roof, you receive your estimate letter and check. Forward the full estimate to info@elkroofingtx.com for review.

steps.title: Roof installation
steps.text: Once approved and we have your signed contract and initial payment, our production team calls to schedule your new roof.

steps.title: Project completion
steps.text: After your new roof is installed along with any supplements, we advise your insurance company and they release any recoverable depreciation.

about.title: Built on legacy. Driven by service. Committed to quality.
text: At ELK Roofing, we're more than just a roofing company. We're a family with a long-standing tradition of craftsmanship, service and integrity. What began as a trusted name in Colorado has grown into a multi-state roofing contractor known for doing things the right way, every time. Now proudly serving Greater Houston and the surrounding communities, our Texas branch brings the same core values, experience and dedication that shaped our reputation out west.

Our roots go deep. The ELK Roofing name has been associated with quality roofing and exceptional service for decades. With years of experience under our belt and thousands of successful projects completed across Colorado, we've built a reputation for standing behind our work, honoring our word and treating every home like our own.

The Houston branch continues that legacy with a hands-on, customer-first approach. We know the challenges homeowners and business owners face, especially in a climate as unpredictable as Southeast Texas. Our team is here to deliver solutions that last, with materials that hold up to the elements and service that earns your trust.

As a local, family-owned business, we understand what it means to be part of the community, and we show up for our neighbors with clear communication, skilled crews and honest, no-pressure guidance. We've seen what poor workmanship and lack of follow-through can do to a homeowner's peace of mind. That's why we operate differently, raising the standard and refusing to cut corners.

facts.heading: Insurance payments and supplements
facts.text: The first insurance check plus your deductible and payment for any upgrades starts the installation process. If insurance has left items off the estimate, we request they include them, along with any discovery work during installation. Supplement checks and recoverable depreciation are due to ELK Roofing when you receive them.
